text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Greek Cypriot press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Turks murder a 58-year old Greek Cypriot in cold blood.
- The new murder may be reported to the Security Council.
- Former foreign minister George Iakovou is a favourite in communist Akel's preferences for a presidential candidate.
- New crime in Achna. Turks cold-bloodedly kill refugee out collecting snails.
- Electricity Authority tender was given to a board member whose company's services are not approved by the state.
- New murder triggers further tension in Cyprus. Petros Kakouli had raised his hands and they shot him.
- Job recruitment agencies come under the scrutiny of the state.
- The United States pushing for the start of a military dialogue on Cyprus.
- Ruthless murderers - Man shot dead by Turks in Achna. Greece expresses concern over the incident.
- Social security will increase pensions and redundancy pay in January.
